title: Conformance Coverage Adversarial Test Vectors
scope: Portable semantic vectors for detecting coverage gaps independently of signing format.

vectors.principle: A valid set of included records does not prove that every required execution is present.
Coverage verification must also surface evidence that falls outside the committed execution obligation.
Positive traceability alone cannot distinguish an unsatisfied requirement from an omitted claim.
An explicit negative outcome is still complete coverage; NOT_SATISFIED is not MISSING.
